stable.notes: v0.43.0: the pinout diagram belongs to the housing (Housings tab gets the pinout box, canvas resolves connector -> housing, two connectors on one housing share one pinout); nets in the node dialog - Net band on the wire table, Group by Net / Function / Connector / Remote device / Wire part with collapsible groups, search, Node switch, Matrix tab; blank wire rows are saved and never vanish; Add Device offers every cavity of the new connectors as a wire row. Needs the 2026-09-22_pinout_to_housing.sql catalog migration (and 2026-09-22_housing_cavities.sql from v0.42.0).

beta.notes: v0.44.0 (beta): autosave - an unsaved project is written to a sidecar every 60 s and offered for recovery at startup / File > Open; toolbar "Place (N)" places a device from the catalog (node named after the device, connectors + cavities + one wire row per pin, one undo entry); BOM grouped by connector assembly (one line per connector part number with its rolled-up price, parts indented under it, CSV + print follow); one DRC rule engine (14 rules with stable ids, Rules... legend, one state -> colour table shared by the DRC window and the node dialog tints, waivers stored in the .project, grouped by Node or Rule); the demo "crash on Cancel" fixed - closed node dialogs now really disconnect from the controller in the packaged build, Discard is one bulk update, and the Save / Discard / Cancel prompt says what Discard throws away; internal terminals (a terminal with no part number, "+ Custom terminal..." on the Connectors tab) and bare-terminal connectors (ring / spade / fork without a phantom housing); node-dialog buttons after Place ("+ Add Another Device", "+ Fill Missing Cavities", the name-this-node prompt only on automatic N-names); wire table edits like a spreadsheet (multi-select, copy / paste, Select Device on a block, Enter opens the editor); type-to-filter pickers for Add Device / Add Connector; right-click menus on every canvas item end with "Properties...", right-clicking a node's name label opens its menu, and a right press never drags. Needs the 2026-09-24_internal_terminals.sql catalog migration (applied on master; customer branches before promote).
